What we build

Four kinds of work, usually combined.

Most engagements start with one painful workflow and touch two or three of these.

  1. 01

    Custom internal tools and portals

    Borrower, investor and client portals. Deal and loan pipelines. Review queues your team works from every morning. Built around your process instead of a template.

  2. 02

    System and core integrations

    Data moves between the CRM, core, property-management and fund-admin systems you already pay for. Nobody re-keys it, and there is no new platform to adopt.

  3. 03

    Document and underwriting automation

    Offering memoranda, rent rolls, T-12s, tax returns and financial statements become structured data, then your model, memo or signed PDF.

  4. 04

    Practical AI workflows

    Extraction, drafting and triage with a person reviewing the output, every figure linked to its source page, and a full audit log.

Capabilities and integrations
Our position on AI

We don’t just use AI. We implement it where it matters.

A person reviews every output

AI drafts and extracts. Your analyst, credit officer or operations lead approves. Nothing reaches a system of record on its own.

Every figure traces to its source

Each extracted value links back to the document and page it came from, so a reviewer can check it in seconds.

Private and zero-retention options

Run models in your own cloud, or through configurations where the provider does not retain your documents.

How it works

From a stack of documents to a record you can trust.

The same five steps sit under almost everything we build. The middle one is a person.

  1. Documents inUploads, email attachments, system exports.
  2. ExtractFields pulled into a fixed structure, with the source page recorded.
  3. ReviewValidation rules run. A person confirms or corrects what is flagged.
  4. System of recordApproved data lands in your model, CRM, core or fund-admin system.
  5. ReportMemos, statements and audit trails generated from approved data.

Working demo · Banking

Commercial loan document portal

Each borrower gets one link to a live checklist of what has arrived and what is missing. The personal financial statement and debt schedule are completed online and come back as clean PDFs. The banker accepts or returns each document and sends reminders listing exactly what is outstanding. Uploads are encrypted at rest.

Built by MonkFlow. Synthetic data, not a client deployment.

Open the demo
Working demo · Commercial real estate

Land search for brokers

Type a client's land request the way they wrote it. The tool sets the filters, checks every parcel in the search area against public county records, and sorts each one as a match, needs a look, or not available, with the owner, zoning and reason. One click produces a client-ready PDF with a numbered map and a page per parcel.

Built by MonkFlow. Synthetic data, not a client deployment.

How we work

A clear scope before we build, and one person accountable throughout.

  1. 01

    Discover

    We map the workflow as it actually runs: who touches it, which systems, where the re-keying and waiting happen.

  2. 02

    Design

    We decide where automation and AI pay for themselves and where they do not. You get a written scope before any build starts.

  3. 03

    Build and deploy

    You see working software early, on your own documents and data, and your team tests it before it goes live.

  4. 04

    Operate and iterate

    After launch you keep a direct line to the engineer who built it, for fixes, changes and the next workflow.

Not sure where to start? Start with a workflow audit.

We map one workflow and the systems around it, rank the automation opportunities, and write up scope and data handling. You decide what, if anything, to build.

Security

Built for firms that answer to examiners, auditors and LPs.

Security and data handling

  • Your data stays in your systems

    We build the workflow layer. We do not keep client PII on our infrastructure.

  • Encrypted throughout

    AES-256 at rest and TLS in transit.

  • Access by role, with a trail

    Role-based access and a log of every action.

  • Private deployment

    Run inside your own cloud, with zero-retention model options.

Bring us your worst manual workflow.

A working session is 20 minutes with the engineer who would build it. Walk through the process, and leave with a straight answer on whether it is worth automating.
